content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ZSS Khordha Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Zilla Swasthya Samiti Khordha (ZSS Khordha), a government health organization.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Counselor, Physiotherapist, WIC Operator, and Data Assistant-cum-Accountant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Since it's a walk-in interview, the last date to apply is the date of the interview itself, which is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the posts available for recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Counselor, Physiotherapist, WIC Operator, and Data Assistant-cum-Accountant.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs.
